name: Key West
tagline: The end of the road, sunset and key lime pie
summary: Key West is the last island of the Florida Keys, reached by the Overseas Highway over turquoise water. Watch the nightly sunset celebration at Mallory Square, visit Hemingway's house and its six-toed cats, take a boat to Dry Tortugas fort, snorkel the reef and eat key lime pie on Duval Street.
seasonNote: Winter is dry and warm; June to November is hurricane season.
arrival: Fly into Key West, or drive about 3.5 hours from Miami on the Overseas Highway.
gettingAround: Walk or bike; the old town is small.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere. Tip 18 to 20 percent at restaurants.
foodTip: Key lime pie, conch fritters, Cuban sandwiches and stone crab.
